headline: Approved Jacqueline Kelley's nomination to the Burlington Advisory Committee on Accessibility.
summary: The committee heard about Jacqueline Kelley's nomination to the Burlington Advisory Committee on Accessibility (BACA) and approved her nomination. BACA also shared updates on upcoming projects. The committee agreed to start future meetings at 8:15 with flexibility for longer sessions if appeals arise.
decisions: Approved Jacqueline Kelley's nomination to BACA.

decision_evidence.quote: AS Moves to approve JKs nomination to BACA. MB Seconds the motion. All in favor, so moved and approved.

plain_text:
Thursday, August 13, 2026, 8:30 AM, 8:30 am, Sharon Bushor 
Conference Room, 149 Church Street, OR Remotely via ZOOM 
 
 
In Attendance:  
Councilor Sarah Carpenter, chair (SC) 
Councilor Allie Schachter (AS) 
Councilor Marek Broderick (MB) 
Lynn Reagan, Director of Human Resources (LR) 
 
Others in Attendance  
Meaghan Diffenderfer, HRPC Staffer (MD) 
Jacqueline Kelley, BACA Nominee (JK) 
Romeo Hermann (RH), Police Commissioner  
 
Call to order: 8:34 am 
 
1. Approve Agenda & Minutes 
  
1.1 Adopt Agenda 
AS moves to approve the agenda.  
MB seconds the motion.  
All in favor, so moved and adopted. 
 
1.2 Approve minutes from the 11/21/25 HRPC Meeting 
AS moves to approve the minutes from the November 21 meeting. 
MB seconds the motion.  
All in favor, so moved and approved. 
 
2. Public Forum 
 
None.  
 
3. BACA Member Approval
MD introduces the Burlington Advisor Committee on Accessibility’s recent 
vote to nominate Jacqueline Kelley for membership, and JK introduces 
herself and her role at UVM and why she is interested in joining BACA.  
 
MD shares updated from BACA about other projects coming down the 
pipeline.  
 
AS Moves to approve JKs nomination to BACA.  
MB Seconds the motion.   
All in favor, so moved and approved.  
 
4. Other Committee Business 
 
Moving forward the committee will meet at 8:15, with flexibility if there are 
appeals and we need a longer meeting time.  
 
5. Adjournment 
 
AS moves to adjourn. 
 
Meeting adjourned, 8:48 am.  
 
6. Informational and Non-Discrimination Statements 
 
The City of Burlington will not tolerate unlawful harassment or 
discrimination on the basis of political or religious affiliation, race, color, 
national origin, place of birth, ancestry, age, sex, sexual orientation, 
gender identity, marital status, veteran status, disability, HIV positive 
status, crime victim status or genetic information. The City is also 
committed to providing proper access to services, facilities and 
employment opportunities. The programs and services of the City of 
Burlington are accessible to people with disabilities. Individuals who 
require special arrangements, auxiliary aid, service for effective

soon as possible but no later than 48 hours before the scheduled event.
